title: Redesign site UI and fix social redirects, forms, timers, and search

requirements.text: Apply a cohesive, modern visual redesign across the entire site (Figma-inspired), improving typography, spacing, color system, and component styling so the site no longer looks "ugly" while keeping all existing pages/routes functional.

quotes: The design was still too ugly do whatever you want to do with it ... just make it better use figma and more for it

acceptanceCriteria: All existing routes render without layout breakage on mobile and desktop.
A single consistent design system is applied (type scale, spacing rhythm, card/button/input styles, and section backgrounds).
Animations (if any) respect reduced-motion preferences and do not introduce continuous heavy effects.

requirements.text: Fix all Telegram and WhatsApp redirects so every Telegram/WhatsApp button/link consistently opens the correct URL in a new tab/window using the centralized constants in frontend/src/constants/socialLinks.ts.

quotes: fix all its functionality redirection to WhatsApp telegram

acceptanceCriteria: All UI links that claim to open Telegram open https://t.me/Rsuperior.
All UI links that claim to open WhatsApp channel open https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VbB6FHV59PwWv9wIE93P.
All UI flows that claim to open WhatsApp direct message open https://wa.me/923294238997 (with optional encoded message querystring when applicable).
No hardcoded Telegram/WhatsApp URLs remain outside frontend/src/constants/socialLinks.ts.

requirements.text: Ensure both primary registration forms (Presale and Airdrop) submit successfully and reliably, including correct backend submission, clear success/error toasts, correct WhatsApp redirect after successful submission, and proper disabled/loading states.

quotes: make sure both forms work properly

acceptanceCriteria: Submitting Presale/Airdrop with valid data calls the backend submitForm successfully and shows a success toast.
Submitting invalid data does not call the backend and shows a validation error.
While submission is in progress, the active form is disabled and shows an in-progress UI state.
After successful submission, WhatsApp opens with a correctly encoded, prefilled message that matches the submitted values.
If the popup is blocked, the UI provides a clear fallback (e.g., a visible link/button) that the user can click to open WhatsApp manually.

requirements.text: Implement timer-based locking behavior for Presale and Airdrop forms according to the roadmap timers: forms must be locked/unlocked strictly based on the backend timer values (presale/airdrop remaining time) and must not allow submission while locked.

quotes: logged with the timer locked with the timer according to roadmap

acceptanceCriteria: When remaining time is 0 (or otherwise indicates lock), the corresponding form is visibly locked and cannot be submitted (UI prevents submit; backend rejects if attempted).
When remaining time is greater than 0 and the form is intended to be available, the form is usable and can be submitted.
The UI countdown updates smoothly and matches the latest backend remaining-time queries.
Locked-state messaging is clear and in English.

requirements.text: Add submission logging/visibility that reflects the timer context: after a successful Presale/Airdrop submission, the user can see a simple log entry showing what was submitted and when (timestamp), and it remains consistent with backend-stored submission records.
acceptanceCriteria: After submitting a form, the UI displays an entry in a "My Submissions" area (or equivalent) that includes: form type (Presale/Airdrop), submitted timestamp, and key submitted fields.
The log is fetched from backend getMySubmissions and updates automatically after successful submission.
No other user’s submissions are visible to a non-admin user.

requirements.text: Fix all other form submissions across the site so they behave correctly with clear validation and user feedback (success/error) and do not silently fail.
acceptanceCriteria: Each page with a form provides English validation errors for required fields.
Each form submission path provides a clear success indicator and a clear failure indicator (no silent failures).
No form can be submitted multiple times unintentionally due to missing disabled/loading handling.

requirements.text: Implement a working search box that allows users to search site content/pages and navigate to relevant results (multipage routing).
acceptanceCriteria: A visible search input exists in the UI (desktop and mobile).
Typing a query shows matching results (at minimum: page titles/primary sections) and selecting a result navigates to the corresponding route.
Search works without requiring authentication.
Empty/no-match states are handled gracefully with English messaging.

requirements.text: Keep the site as a multipage application (existing router-based navigation), while improving usability (navigation clarity, consistent page shells/headers/footers) as part of the redesign.

quotes: make it for multipage or single scroll website do whatever you want

acceptanceCriteria: All existing routes remain accessible via navigation on both desktop and mobile.
No route becomes unreachable due to redesign changes.
Scroll position behavior remains sensible on route changes (no confusing partial scroll states).

constraints: Use English for all user-facing text.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutablePaths; compose those components instead.
Do not remove or change the existing Telegram/WhatsApp URLs defined in frontend/src/constants/socialLinks.ts; ensure the app uses them consistently.
nonGoals: Adding third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Adding external databases or third-party analytics/search services.
Changing the project into a Next.js/Vue/Angular app.

required: Abstract premium hero background with subtle gold/charcoal gradients and light noise texture (hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png)
Minimal monoline icon set (telegram, whatsapp, search, form) in a consistent style (ui-icons.dim_512x512.png)
Soft section-divider graphic with smoky/gold motif (section-divider.dim_1920x240.png)

preferencesToAdd: Prefer a Figma-inspired modern visual redesign; prioritize aesthetics and UX polish while preserving/fixing core functionality.
